title: Next instruction at a copy site
statement: For natural numbers $a$, $b$, and $f$, the next instruction associated to each copy site is: $X$ leads to the first decrement of $x$, $T$ to the first increment of $t$, $TC$ to the radius test, $CN$ to setting $c=e+1$, $MN$ to the copy site $CM$, $CM$ to the initial phase of the shift site $M$, $KM$ to setting $c=1$, $QP$ to the end test with remembered bit true, $UI$ to the copy site $CU$, $CU$ to the initial phase of halving $u$, $TU$ to the copy site $CT$, and $CT$ to the initial phase of the shift site $T$.
